pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Obsidian" to quit' && sleep 2 && rm -rf ~/Documents/ResearchVault
instruction: Create a new Obsidian vault named "ResearchVault" in ~/Documents directory, and add a new note named “Ideas.md” with the text "# My Ideas".
evaluator: [ -d ~/Documents/ResearchVault/.obsidian ] && [ -s ~/Documents/ResearchVault/Ideas.md ] && grep -qx '# My Ideas' ~/Documents/ResearchVault/Ideas.md && echo True || echo False
